color.description:
The background and border color that represents the user. This should be
represented as a value that can be read by CSS

getUploadParams.description:
A callback that receives a file object and returns a `UploadParams` needed
to upload the file.

More info is available at:
https://atlantis.getjobber.com/components/InputFile

imageUrl.description:
A URL for the image that will be displayed
@deprecated Use `src` instead.

initials.description: The initials that will be displayed if no image is set.\

name.description: A users name to be used for assistive technology

onChange.description: Triggered when an image is changed.

onUploadComplete.description: Triggered when an image upload has completed.

src.description: A URL for the image that will be displayed

testID.description: A reference to the element in the rendered output
